title: Product Manager, AI Trip Planning
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.
 The Guest product team owns and builds the end-to-end journey guests take to travel with us, from the first idea through the trip itself. Trip planning is where that journey becomes intelligent: a team of engineers, applied researchers, designers, and data scientists building an AI planning agent that can understand what guests are looking for, and reason across homes, experiences, services and more to assemble a real trip. We're building toward a future where Airbnb feels like a knowledgeable travel companion that plans alongside you.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 As Product Manager for AI trip planning, you will own the strategy and execution for this agent — one of Airbnb's most ambitious bets on an AI-native product. You'll define what it means for an agent to plan a trip well: how it asks the right questions, reasons about tradeoffs guests care about, and turns intent into a bookable trip spanning homes, experiences, and services. You’ll take the product from a demo to a system millions of guests rely on, and the work will be measured in bookings across categories and guest sat…

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

 

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

title: Senior Director, Head of Tax (all genders)
description:
About the role 

As a Senior Director Tax, you will lead the Group Tax Department, overseeing all group-wide tax matters and a team of four professionals. This is a strategic yet hands-on role where you will develop group-wide tax optimization opportunities, lead tax audits, and continuously evolve the group tax and transfer pricing strategy. You will be part of the Group Finance Leadership Team, working closely with the CFO and company leadership to ensure tax compliance and support special projects.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the team: You will lead and manage the Group Tax Department, which includes direct responsibility for a team of four skilled professionals.
  • Manage tax matters: You will be responsible for all group-wide tax matters, collaborating with local and international group companies on various aspects of (corporate) tax law.
  • Develop strategy: You will continuously develop the group tax and transfer pricing strategy for the Group and identify group-wide tax optimization opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance: You will oversee the group’s tax compliance activities, including preparing corporate income tax and VAT returns for German group companies.
  • Oversee financial reporting: You will be responsible for deferred tax positions (IFRS and HGB) in annual, consolidated, and quarterly financial statements, as well as financial planning.
  • Handle audits: You will lead tax audits and appeal proceedings, and be responsible for selecting and coordinating external consultants.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of professional experience in a similar leadership role within an international company's tax department or a leading international tax consultancy.
